meta.subject: disabling fetch's deadlock check when L1 caches are present

en.summary: Fixes fetch-stage throttling so the ibuffer deadlock workaround is only active in shared-bus configurations, not when L1 caches give fetch its own path.
why_it_counts: The patch changes active fetch and decode pipeline control logic.
The surrounding comments explicitly tie the old workaround to a shared I-cache and D-cache bus scenario.
Leaving that workaround enabled in L1-cache builds can block forward progress in a real DUT configuration.
evidence: hw/rtl/VX_define.vh adds a derived `L1_ENABLE macro when ICACHE_ENABLE or DCACHE_ENABLE is set.
In hw/rtl/core/VX_fetch.sv, the pending ibuffer fullness tracking and ibuf_pop-based throttling are wrapped in `ifndef L1_ENABLE, and ibuf_ready becomes 1'b1 when L1 is present.
hw/rtl/core/VX_decode.sv, hw/rtl/core/VX_ibuffer.sv, hw/rtl/interfaces/VX_decode_if.sv, and hw/rtl/interfaces/VX_fetch_if.sv all conditionally remove ibuf_pop plumbing under L1_ENABLE.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A fetch deadlock workaround that throttles instruction requests based on ibuffer occupancy is only appropriate when fetch and data traffic truly contend for the same constrained downstream path. If a design later adds private L1 paths or otherwise separates instruction and data traffic, keeping the old workaround creates a false dependency and can stall fetch even though the original shared-bus hazard no longer exists.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Instruction fetch and data traffic no longer share the same bottleneck, but the fetch stage still enforces a shared-bus ibuffer-throttle rule.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Keep the shared-bus deadlock-prevention throttle enabled in configurations with separate instruction and data paths.
portability_notes: Map this to any fetch-stage occupancy workaround that was introduced for a bus-sharing configuration.
The bug depends on configuration, not on a single instruction type.
The injected fault should preserve the workaround logic but remove the guard that disables it in separated-cache configurations.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify the fetch-stage condition that blocks new instruction requests when the instruction buffer is near full.
Ignore or remove the configuration predicate that says the workaround is only needed when instruction and data traffic share a path.
Keep the ibuffer-pop or occupancy-based ready gating active in configurations with separate L1 or otherwise independent fetch bandwidth.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: fetch-to-ibuffer deadlock throttle and ibuf_pop plumbing under L1_ENABLE
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit introduces L1_ENABLE, disables the ibuffer deadlock workaround when L1 caches are present, and removes the related ibuf_pop interface plumbing in that configuration.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Remove the L1_ENABLE guards so VX_fetch.sv always tracks pending_ibuf_full and the fetch and decode interfaces always carry ibuf_pop.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: In L1-enabled configurations, fetch can be throttled unnecessarily or deadlock because a shared-bus workaround remains active after the shared-bus assumption stopped being true.
evidence_for_injection: The original comments in VX_fetch.sv state that the workaround is specifically for the case where icache and dcache share the same bus.
The fix makes ibuf_ready unconditional under L1_ENABLE and deletes the now-unneeded ibuf_pop plumbing.
The change spans fetch, decode, ibuffer, and the associated interfaces, showing this is an active control-path change.
notes: The interface changes are support plumbing; the core bug is the stale configuration guard.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了取指阶段的限流逻辑：ibuffer 死锁规避机制只应在共享总线配置下启用，而不应在存在 L1 cache、取指拥有独立路径时继续生效。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是实际工作的 fetch 与 decode 流水线控制逻辑。
周边注释明确说明旧规避逻辑只适用于 I-cache 与 D-cache 共用总线的场景。
如果在带 L1 cache 的真实 DUT 配置中继续启用该规避逻辑，就可能阻断前向推进。
evidence: hw/rtl/VX_define.vh 在 ICACHE_ENABLE 或 DCACHE_ENABLE 打开时新增派生宏 `L1_ENABLE。
在 hw/rtl/core/VX_fetch.sv 中，pending ibuffer 满度统计与基于 ibuf_pop 的限流被放入 `ifndef L1_ENABLE，下有 L1 时 ibuf_ready 直接变为 1'b1。
hw/rtl/core/VX_decode.sv、hw/rtl/core/VX_ibuffer.sv、hw/rtl/interfaces/VX_decode_if.sv 和 hw/rtl/interfaces/VX_fetch_if.sv 都在 L1_ENABLE 下条件性移除了 ibuf_pop 传递。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 一种基于 ibuffer 占用来限制取指请求的死锁规避逻辑，只在取指流量与数据流量确实争用同一受限下游路径时才合理。如果设计后来加入了私有 L1 路径，或者以其他方式把取指与数据流量分开，而仍保留旧的规避逻辑，就会人为制造不存在的依赖关系，使 fetch 即使在原始共享总线隐患已消失时仍然停滞。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 依赖配置的 fetch 反压保护逻辑
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 取指流量与数据流量已经不再共享同一瓶颈，但 fetch 阶段仍然执行面向共享总线场景的 ibuffer 限流规则。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在指令和数据路径已经分离的配置里，仍然保留共享总线死锁规避限流。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 跨配置遗留的死锁保护条件
portability_notes: 把它映射到任何仅为共享总线配置引入的 fetch 阶段占用规避逻辑。
这个缺陷依赖配置，而不是依赖某条特定指令。
注入时应保留原始规避逻辑，只去掉在分离 cache 配置下关闭它的那层门控。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到取指阶段中基于指令缓冲区接近满而阻止新请求发出的条件。
忽略或移除说明“只有在指令和数据流量共享路径时才需要该规避”的配置谓词。
在存在独立 L1 或其他独立取指带宽的配置中，继续保留基于 ibuffer pop 或占用统计的 ready 限流。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: L1_ENABLE 条件下的 fetch 到 ibuffer 死锁限流与 ibuf_pop 传递
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交引入了 L1_ENABLE，在存在 L1 cache 时关闭 ibuffer 死锁规避路径，并删除该配置下不再需要的 ibuf_pop 接口传递。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 去掉 L1_ENABLE 相关条件，使 VX_fetch.sv 始终跟踪 pending_ibuf_full，并让 fetch 和 decode 接口始终携带 ibuf_pop。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在启用 L1 的配置下，fetch 会因为继续套用共享总线场景的规避逻辑而被错误限流，严重时可导致死锁。
evidence_for_injection: VX_fetch.sv 中原始注释明确指出该规避逻辑只适用于 icache 与 dcache 共用总线的情况。
修复在 L1_ENABLE 下把 ibuf_ready 变为无条件，并删除了相关 ibuf_pop 传递。
该改动同时跨越 fetch、decode、ibuffer 及其接口，说明它是实际控制路径变化。
notes: 接口改动只是配套传递层面的调整，核心缺陷是配置门控过期。
